crossRefs.note: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty…
They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun…

translations.web: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
translations.bsb: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,
translations.kjv: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
